hero.heading: Everything you share, at one address
hero.body: Put your links on a single page people can visit at your username — and see what they actually click.

features.heading: What you get
features.body: Everything listed here is in the product today.

links.title: Your links, your order
links.body: Each link has a title, an optional description and icon, and its own colours. Drag them into the order you want. Hide one without deleting it — its past clicks stay.

social.title: Social accounts
social.body: Add the accounts you want shown as icons on your page. New platforms can be added without a new release.

design.title: Your own look
design.body: Pick an accent colour and a background — a flat colour, a gradient, or an image. Your page, not a template with your name on it.

analytics.title: Numbers that mean something
analytics.body: Clicks per link, profile views, a day-by-day chart, and which sites your visitors arrived from. Repeat clicks from the same visitor are not counted twice.

preview.title: Looks right when shared
preview.body: Your page generates its own preview card, so a link to it shows your name and picture instead of a blank box.

adult.title: Age warning, if you need it
adult.body: Turn on a confirmation screen before your page opens. The content stays hidden until the visitor confirms — not just visually, but out of the page entirely.

cta.heading: Start with one link
cta.body: Creating a page takes a minute. You can change everything about it afterwards.
